verses.1: As the Lord, the army of Israel’s God, said: “Be careful! For the proud and arrogant have been captured. Their pride has led them to destruction.”
verses.2: There is no longer any hope for Moab. Those who think evil of it will be destroyed and scattered from the land. Then you will go into destruction.
verses.3: A cry of pain came from my ears; a great pain and suffering.
verses.4: She was freed from her suffering; her young daughter cried out in pain.
verses.5: For when the lips are raised in praise, it will also bring praise. For in those who are full of joy, there will be no need for cries of sorrow.
verses.6: Let your souls be freed from their bondage, and let them become like wild animals in the wilderness.
verses.7: For by your actions and your achievements, you will also be united with me. Then, just as the priests and scribes do, you will also be together.
verses.8: And the Redeemer will come to every city. But no city will be saved; the strong will be destroyed, and the righteous will be victorious. As Jehovah has said.
verses.9: Give a chance to Moab; for when it comes out, its cities will be filled with people.
verses.10: A warrior who does God’s work; a warrior who brings destruction from blood.
verses.11: He was gentle and quiet from his youth. He did not act recklessly in any situation. In times of trouble, he remained calm and composed. His character and scent were unforgettable.
verses.12: So now, let these days come! The Lord has spoken; I have sent forth the locusts to devour them. Their bodies will be destroyed, and their flesh will be scattered everywhere.
verses.13: And the house of Moab was destroyed just as the house of Israel was destroyed from the house of El.
verses.14: How will we, the nobles and rulers, speak during this war?
verses.15: Shudad Moav and its cities rose up, but from their chosen places they were brought down. May the name of the King Jehovah’s army be praised.
verses.16: His approach is close and threatening; his evil nature becomes evident quickly.
verses.17: All those around him, and all those who knew his name, said, “How can one be free from the bondage of pride and arrogance?”
verses.18: Redi from the abyss, and Shvi’i in the darkness. She sits in the valley of Dibon, as if she has saved those who are in distress from your captivity.
verses.19: To the path where I stood, and where she sits, in a state of chaos. What will become of her?
verses.20: Hobish Moab cried out in pain, and they cried out loudly. They said, “Let us die in Arnon, for Moab has been defeated.”
verses.21: And judgment came upon the land of Mishor, upon Cholon and Yehzah, and upon Mif’at.
verses.22: And on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on the house of Diblathaim.
verses.23: And on their roofs, and on the houses of Gamul, and on the houses of Meon.
verses.24: And upon all cities in the land, both far and near.
verses.25: May the branches of Moab be cut down, and may their seeds be scattered far away. May the LORD do so!
verses.26: He was hired because Jehovah had magnified him. He was a man of great wisdom and knowledge. He could also play music.
verses.27: And if playing wasn’t meant for you, Israel, then it seems that your words are not worthy of being spoken.
verses.28: They left their cities and took refuge in the rocks. The people of Moab became like birds that fly through the air.
verses.29: We heard the loud cries of Goyon-Moab. His voice was so loud and powerful. His cries were also very loud.
verses.30: I know the words of Jehovah, but they were not spoken in that manner. They did not act in that way either.
verses.31: Therefore, on the day of judgment, all those who are evil will cry out to the people of Kir-Haresh.
verses.32: From my prayers, may Ebe help you. The grape has fallen; it’s over. They crossed the sea. May they touch your lips and your breasts. The rescuer has fallen.
verses.33: And joy and gladness gathered together from Kiryat Arba and from the land of Moab. I was taken away, but my hands did not move. They did not move at all.
verses.34: In their cries of despair, they cried out until they reached Elah. They cried out until they reached Yahatz. Their voices were filled with sorrow and despair. It was like a donkey that was being led around by its owner’s hand.
verses.35: And I was brought back to Moab, by the command of the LORD. He raised me up from the ground, and he offered me to his God.
verses.36: Therefore, my heart will be like those who are lost and abandoned. My heart will be with those who are in the wilderness, just like those who are lost. Therefore, all that was done by our ancestors will be destroyed.
verses.37: For every head of snow, and every old tree, they place it on every hand and on every branch.
verses.38: On all the corners of Moab, and in its depths, there is a spread of destruction. For I have destroyed Moab completely; there is nothing left in it anymore. May the LORD have mercy on us!
verses.39: How Hililu was transformed; how Moab’s eyes were turned towards him, and he became someone who could play and dance for everyone around him.
verses.40: For thus said Jehovah: “Behold, the serpent will rise up and spread its wings towards Moab.”
verses.41: The dogs and the wild animals were caught, and they became prey for the rulers of Moab on that day. They became like dogs belonging to a woman who was captured.
verses.42: And he will be vindicated by God, because He is great in His love for His people.
verses.43: Fear, terror, and dread will be upon you. May the Lord have mercy on you.
verses.44: The one who is overcome by fear will fall into the pit. And from the pit, he will be captured and trapped there. For I will bring him to the place of his punishment, says Jehovah.
verses.45: In the shadow of their thoughts, they stood there, as if fire had erupted from those thoughts. Light came from between the clouds, and it consumed the branches of the trees.
verses.46: Oh, how sad! A people has been lost just like this. Your children and your daughters have been taken away from us.
verses.47: And I rested in Moab for some time. Then, the Lord said, “Let the judgment against Moab continue until now.”
